plugin.name: Skinner_v2
plugin.author: Myrddin, ChatGPT
plugin.description:
Skinner v2
A complete rewrite focused on reliability, maintainability and sequential processing.

trigger.name: Skinner_NoCorpse
trigger.match: You didn't find a corpse suitable for skinning.

trigger.name: Skinner_SkinFail
trigger.match: You carve the corpse into a complete mess! You need more practice.

muclient.script:
--Constants VERSION = "2.00"
PLUGIN_NAME = "Skinner v2"
PLUGIN_COLOR = "khaki" require "serialize" require "wait" require "commas" require "gmcphelper"
------------------------------------------------ -- Alias Handler ------------------------------------------------ function AliasSkinner(name, line, wildcards) --ColourNote("yellow", "", "AliasSkinner called.") local command = wildcards[1] or ""
command = command:lower()
------------------------------------------------ -- No argument ------------------------------------------------
if command == "" then Skinner.UI.Print("Skinner v"..VERSION) Skinner.UI.Print("Type 'skinner status' for information.") return end
------------------------------------------------ -- Status ------------------------------------------------
if command == "status" then
Skinner.UI.Print("Version "..VERSION) Skinner.UI.Print("Enabled: "..tostring(Skinner.Config.enabled)) Skinner.UI.Print("State: "..Skinner.Session.state) Skinner.UI.Print("Skin Type: "..Skinner.Config.skintype) Skinner.UI.Print("Total Skins: "..Skinner.Stats.totalSkins)
return
end ------------------------------------------------ -- Help ------------------------------------------------
if command == "help" then
Skinner.UI.Print("Skinner help commands - Skinner Version "..VERSION) Skinner.UI.Print("skinner help: shows this list of commands") Skinner.UI.Print("skinner enable: Turns ON automatic skinning after combat") Skinner.UI.Print("skinner disable: Turns OFF automatic skinning") Skinner.UI.Print("----------------------------------------------------------------") Skinner.UI.Print("To set skin type, use: ") Skinner.UI.Print("skinner cloak|leggings|helm|sleeves|gloves|boots") Skinner.UI.Print("----------------------------------------------------------------") Skinner.UI.Print("By default, we will preserve all bonus loot skins, and drop rest") Skinner.UI.Print("----------------------------------------------------------------") Skinner.UI.Print("Skinner stats : will show all-time data (local print only)") Skinner.UI.Print("Skinner report <chan>: will report data to given channel, ie-gtell") Skinner.UI.Print("----------------------------------------------------------------") Skinner.UI.Print("skinner debug on: Turns ON DEBUG messages (SPAM WARNING)") Skinner.UI.Print("skinner debug off: Turns OFF DEBUG messages") return end
------------------------------------------------ -- Enable ------------------------------------------------
if command == "enable" then Skinner.Engine.Enable() return end
------------------------------------------------ -- Disable ------------------------------------------------
if command == "disable" then Skinner.Engine.Disable() return end ------------------------------------------------ -- Cloak ------------------------------------------------
if command == "cloak" then Skinner.Config.skintype = "cloak" Skinner.UI.Print("Skin Type set to: "..Skinner.Config.skintype) return end ------------------------------------------------ -- Helm ------------------------------------------------
if command == "helm" then Skinner.Config.skintype = "helm" Skinner.UI.Print("Skin Type set to: "..Skinner.Config.skintype) return end
------------------------------------------------ -- Leggings ------------------------------------------------
if command == "leggings" then Skinner.Config.skintype = "leggings" Skinner.UI.Print("Skin Type set to: "..Skinner.Config.skintype) return end
------------------------------------------------ -- Gloves ------------------------------------------------
if command == "gloves" then Skinner.Config.skintype = "gloves" Skinner.UI.Print("Skin Type set to: "..Skinner.Config.skintype) return end
------------------------------------------------ -- Boots ------------------------------------------------
if command == "boots" then Skinner.Config.skintype = "boots" Skinner.UI.Print("Skin Type set to: "..Skinner.Config.skintype) return end
------------------------------------------------ -- Stats ------------------------------------------------
if command == "stats" then Skinner.UI.PrintStats() return end
------------------------------------------------ -- Report ------------------------------------------------ if command == "report" or command:match("^report%s+") then
local channel = command:match("^report%s+(.*)$")
Skinner.UI.PrintReport(channel)
return
end
------------------------------------------------ -- Debug ------------------------------------------------
if command == "debug on" then Skinner.Config.debug = true Skinner.Engine.Save() Skinner.UI.Print("Debug enabled.") return end
if command == "debug off" then Skinner.Config.debug = false Skinner.Engine.Save() Skinner.UI.Print("Debug disabled.") return end
------------------------------------------------ -- Unknown ------------------------------------------------
Skinner.UI.Print( "Unknown command (use skinner help): " .. command ) end
-------------------------------------------------- -- GMCP Broadcast Handler --------------------------------------------------
function OnPluginBroadcast(msg, id, name, text) -- Ignore broadcasts from other plugins if id ~= "3e7dedbe37e44942dd46d264" then return end
-- We only care about character status updates if text ~= "char.status" then return end local res, gmcparg = CallPlugin( "3e7dedbe37e44942dd46d264", "gmcpval", "char.status" ) --Skinner.Debug.Log("GMCP raw: " .. tostring(gmcparg))
if res ~= error_code.eOK then return end
--local gmcpdata local luastmt = "gmcpdata = " .. gmcparg assert(loadstring(luastmt))() if not gmcpdata then Skinner.Debug.Log("GMCP parse failed.") return end Skinner.Debug.Log( "GMCP state: " .. tostring(gmcpdata.state) .. " (" .. tostring(gmcpdata.pos) .. ")" )
local state = tonumber(gmcpdata.state)
-- Combat started if state == 8 then Skinner.Session.inCombat = true return end
-- Combat ended if state == 3 and Skinner.Session.inCombat then if Skinner.Config.enabled == false then return end Skinner.Session.inCombat = false Skinner.Engine.SetState(Skinner.State.SCANNING) EnableTrigger("Skinner_Exits", true) --Skinner.Debug.Log("Combat ended. Starting skinning session.") Skinner.Engine.StartSession() end end
-------------------------------------------------- -- Event Handlers (called by triggers) --------------------------------------------------
function OnCorpseFound(name, line, wildcards) if Skinner.Session.state ~= Skinner.State.SCANNING then return end local count = tonumber(wildcards[1]) if not count then count = 1 end Skinner.Debug.Log( string.format("Found %d corpse(s).", count) ) Skinner.Engine.QueueCorpse(count)
end
function OnSkinSuccess() Skinner.Debug.Log("Corpse skinned") Skinner.Engine.RecordSkin() Skinner.Engine.SkinSucceeded() end
function OnSkinFailed(name, line, wildcards) Skinner.Debug.Log("Skin attempt failed: " .. line) Skinner.Engine.RecordFailure() Skinner.Engine.SkinFailed() end
function OnBonus(name, line, wildcards) local quality = wildcards[1] quality = quality:gsub("[()]", "") Skinner.Engine.RecordBonus(quality) Skinner.Engine.AddBonus(quality) end
function OnLookFinished(name, line, wildcards) Skinner.Debug.Log("Exit Trigger Fired.") EnableTrigger("Skinner_Exits", false) EnableTrigger("Skinner_Corpse", true) EnableTrigger("Skinner_findPrompt", true) Skinner.Debug.Log( "Corpse trigger enabled = " .. tostring(GetTriggerOption("Skinner_Corpse","enabled")) ) end
function OnPrompt(name, line, wildcards) -- starts the skinning process if Skinner.Session.state ~= Skinner.State.SCANNING then return end Skinner.Debug.Log("Prompt detected. Room scan complete.") EnableTrigger("Skinner_Exits", false) EnableTrigger("Skinner_Corpse", false) EnableTrigger("Skinner_findPrompt", false)
Skinner.Engine.RoomScanFinished() --starts skinning end
Skinner = {
State = { IDLE = "IDLE", SCANNING = "SCANNING", SKINNING = "SKINNING",
}, Config = {}, Stats = {}, Session = {}, Engine = {}, UI = {}, Debug = {} }
--Default Config Skinner.Config = { enabled = true, skintype = "cloak", preserve = "bloot", autoDrop = true, autoBag = false, bag = "", debug = true, finalBonusDelay = 0.35 }
-- Statistics Skinner.Stats = { totalSkins = 0, failedSkins = 0, totalBonuses = 0,
qualities = {} }
-- State function Skinner.Engine.SetState(newState) Skinner.Session.state = newState Skinner.Debug.Log("State -> " .. newState) end
-- Session while processing one room Skinner.Session = { state = Skinner.State.IDLE, corpseQueue = {}, bonusCounts = {}, inCombat = false, currentCorpse = nil, skinsCompleted = 0, skinsFailed = 0, finishingRoom = false }
------------------------------------------------ -- Statistics ------------------------------------------------
function Skinner.Engine.RecordSkin()
Skinner.Stats.totalSkins = Skinner.Stats.totalSkins + 1
end
function Skinner.Engine.RecordFailure()
Skinner.Stats.failedSkins = Skinner.Stats.failedSkins + 1
end
function Skinner.Engine.RecordBonus(quality)
Skinner.Stats.totalBonuses = Skinner.Stats.totalBonuses + 1
Skinner.Stats.qualities[quality] = (Skinner.Stats.qualities[quality] or 0) + 1
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- Core Engine --------------------------------------------------
-- Start a new skinning session function Skinner.Engine.StartSession() Skinner.Debug.Log("Session Started.") --if Skinner.Session.state ~= Skinner.Session.SCANNING then -- return --end Skinner.Debug.Log("Session Started and passed state check.") if not Skinner.Config.enabled then return end Skinner.Session.inCombat = false Skinner.Session.corpseQueue = {} Skinner.Session.bonusCounts = {} Skinner.Session.currentCorpse = nil Skinner.Session.skinsCompleted = 0 Skinner.Session.skinsFailed = 0 EnableTrigger("Skinner_Exits", true) EnableTrigger("Skinner_findPrompt",false) --EnableTrigger("Skinner_Corpse", true) Skinner.Debug.Log( "Corpse trigger enabled = " .. tostring(GetTriggerOption("Skinner_Corpse","enabled")) ) Skinner.Debug.Log("Sending LOOK.") Skinner.Engine.SendCommand("look") end
function Skinner.Engine.QueueCorpse(count) count = count or 1 for i = 1, count do table.insert(Skinner.Session.corpseQueue, true) end Skinner.Debug.Log( string.format( "Queued %d corpse(s). Queue=%d", count, #Skinner.Session.corpseQueue ) ) end
function Skinner.Engine.RoomScanFinished() local count = #Skinner.Session.corpseQueue Skinner.Debug.Log( string.format( "Room scan complete. %d corpses found.", count ) ) Skinner.Engine.SetState( Skinner.State.SKINNING ) Skinner.Engine.ProcessNextCorpse() end
function Skinner.Engine.ProcessNextCorpse() Skinner.Debug.Log("ProcessNextCorpse Called.") EnableTrigger("Skinner_Corpse", false) if Skinner.Config.enabled == false then return end if #Skinner.Session.corpseQueue == 0 then
Skinner.Debug.Log("All corpses processed.") Skinner.Debug.Log("Waiting briefly for final bonus output.") Skinner.Session.finishingRoom = true
DoAfterSpecial( Skinner.Config.finalBonusDelay, "Skinner.Engine.ProcessBonuses()", sendto.script )
return
end Skinner.Engine.SetState(Skinner.State.SKINNING) Skinner.Debug.Log( string.format( "%d corpses remaining.", #Skinner.Session.corpseQueue ) ) Skinner.Engine.SendCommand( "skin " .. Skinner.Config.skintype ) end
function Skinner.Engine.SkinSucceeded() if Skinner.Config.enabled == false then return end Skinner.Debug.Log("Skin succeeded") -- Remove the corpse we just finished table.remove(Skinner.Session.corpseQueue, 1) Skinner.Session.skinsCompleted = Skinner.Session.skinsCompleted + 1 Skinner.Debug.Log( string.format( "Skin successful (%d completed).", Skinner.Session.skinsCompleted ) ) Skinner.Engine.ProcessNextCorpse() end
function Skinner.Engine.SkinFailed() Skinner.Debug.Log("Skin Failed") -- Remove the corpse we attempted table.remove(Skinner.Session.corpseQueue, 1) Skinner.Session.skinsFailed = Skinner.Session.skinsFailed + 1 Skinner.Debug.Log( string.format( "Skin failed (%d failed).", Skinner.Session.skinsFailed ) ) Skinner.Engine.ProcessNextCorpse() end
function Skinner.Engine.ProcessBonuses() if not Skinner.Session.finishingRoom then return end
Skinner.Session.finishingRoom = false
for quality, count in pairs(Skinner.Session.bonusCounts) do local keyword = quality:lower() for i = count, 1, -1 do local item = i .. "." .. keyword Skinner.Engine.SendCommand("keep " .. item) Skinner.Debug.Log("bonus detected") if Skinner.Config.preserve == "bloot" then Skinner.Engine.SendCommand("preserve " .. item) end
if Skinner.Config.autoBag then Skinner.Engine.SendCommand( "put " .. item .. " " .. Skinner.Config.bag ) end
end
end Skinner.Engine.ProcessDrop()
end
function Skinner.Engine.Abort() Skinner.UI.Print("Session abort called") Skinner.Debug.Log( "Session aborted." ) Skinner.Session.corpseQueue = {} Skinner.Session.bonusCounts = {} Skinner.Session.currentCorpse = nil Skinner.Engine.SetState( Skinner.State.IDLE ) EnableTrigger("Skinner_Exits", false) end
function Skinner.Engine.SendCommand(cmd)
Skinner.Debug.Log("SEND>> " .. cmd) Send(cmd) --should be the only Send() in script
end
function Skinner.Engine.AddBonus(quality) local counts = Skinner.Session.bonusCounts counts[quality] = (counts[quality] or 0) + 1
Skinner.Debug.Log(string.format( "*** BONUS DETECTED: %s (%d total this room)", quality, counts[quality] )) end
function Skinner.Engine.ProcessDrop() if Skinner.Config.enabled == false then return end Skinner.Debug.Log("Drop Process triggered") if Skinner.Config.autoDrop then Skinner.Engine.SendCommand( "drop all." ..Skinner.Config.skintype ) Skinner.Debug.Log( "Dropped normal skins." ) end Skinner.Engine.EndSession()
end
function Skinner.Engine.EndSession() Skinner.Debug.Log("END SESSION triggered") Skinner.Engine.PrintSummary() Skinner.Engine.ResetSession() end
function Skinner.Engine.PrintSummary() -- shows room summary Skinner.UI.Print("-----") Skinner.UI.Print( "Completed: " .. Skinner.Session.skinsCompleted ) Skinner.UI.Print( "Failed: " .. Skinner.Session.skinsFailed ) for quality,count in pairs(Skinner.Session.bonusCounts) do Skinner.UI.Print( quality ..": " ..count ) end Skinner.UI.Print("-----") Skinner.UI.Print("Room complete.") end
function Skinner.Engine.Save() OnPluginSaveState() end
-- Prints to screen messages function Skinner.UI.Print(msg) ColourNote("khaki","","[Skinner] "..msg) end
--------------------------------------- -- Statistics Table helper functions --------------------------------------- function Skinner.UI.TableLine(text, colour) ColourNote( colour or "white", "", text ) end
------------------------------------- -- Statistics Report ------------------------------------- function Skinner.UI.PrintStats() local stats = Skinner.Stats stats.totalSkins = stats.totalSkins or 0 stats.failedSkins = stats.failedSkins or 0 stats.totalBonuses = stats.totalBonuses or 0 stats.qualities = stats.qualities or {}
local bonusRate = 0
if stats.totalSkins > 0 then bonusRate = (stats.totalBonuses / stats.totalSkins) * 100 end ------------------------------------------------ -- Build sortable quality list ------------------------------------------------ local qualities = {}
for quality, count in pairs(stats.qualities) do
table.insert(qualities, { quality = quality, count = count })
end
table.sort(qualities,
function(a, b)
return a.count > b.count
end
) ------------------------------------------------ -- Header ------------------------------------------------
Skinner.UI.TableLine( "========================================================", "cyan" ) Skinner.UI.TableLine( " Skinner Statistics", "yellow" ) Skinner.UI.TableLine( "========================================================", "cyan" ) Skinner.UI.TableLine("", "white")
------------------------------------------------ -- General ------------------------------------------------
Skinner.UI.TableLine("General", "yellow") Skinner.UI.TableLine("-------", "yellow")
Skinner.UI.TableLine( string.format( "%-24s %10s", "Total Skins", commas(stats.totalSkins) ), "white" )
Skinner.UI.TableLine( string.format( "%-24s %10s", "Failed Skins", commas(stats.failedSkins) ), "white" )
Skinner.UI.TableLine( string.format( "%-24s %9.2f%%", "Bonus Rate", bonusRate ), "white" )
Skinner.UI.TableLine("", "white")
------------------------------------------------ -- Quality Breakdown ------------------------------------------------ Skinner.UI.TableLine("Quality Breakdown", "yellow")
Skinner.UI.TableLine( string.format( "%-18s %8s %9s %9s", "Quality", "Count", "% Total", "% Bloot" ), "yellow" )
Skinner.UI.TableLine( "------------------------------------------------------------", "yellow" ) for _, item in ipairs(qualities) do
local blootPercent = 0 local totalPercent = 0
if stats.totalBonuses > 0 then blootPercent = (item.count / stats.totalBonuses) * 100 end
if stats.totalSkins > 0 then totalPercent = (item.count / stats.totalSkins) * 100 end
Skinner.UI.TableLine( string.format( "%-18s %8s %8.2f%% %8.2f%%", item.quality, commas(item.count), totalPercent, blootPercent ), "white" )
end
Skinner.UI.TableLine("", "white")
------------------------------------------------ -- Footer ------------------------------------------------ Skinner.UI.TableLine( "============================================================", "cyan" )
end
------------------------------------------------ -- Channel Report ------------------------------------------------
function Skinner.UI.PrintReport(channel)
local stats = Skinner.Stats
if stats.totalSkins == 0 then
local text = "Skinner: No statistics recorded."
if channel and channel ~= "" then Skinner.Engine.SendCommand(channel .. " " .. text) else Skinner.UI.Print(text) end
return
end
-------------------------------------------- -- Build sorted quality list --------------------------------------------
local qualities = {}
for quality, count in pairs(stats.qualities) do
table.insert(qualities,{ quality = quality, count = count })
end
table.sort(qualities,
function(a,b)
return a.count > b.count
end
)
-------------------------------------------- -- Base Report --------------------------------------------
local report = string.format(
"Skinner: %s skins | Bonus %.2f%%",
commas(stats.totalSkins),
(stats.totalBonuses / stats.totalSkins) * 100
)
-------------------------------------------- -- Append Quality Percentages --------------------------------------------
for _,item in ipairs(qualities) do
report = report ..
string.format(
" | %s %.2f%%",
item.quality,
(item.count / stats.totalSkins) * 100
)
end
-------------------------------------------- -- Send or Print --------------------------------------------
if channel and channel ~= "" then
Skinner.Engine.SendCommand(channel .. " " .. report)
else
Skinner.UI.Print(report)
end
end
------------------------------------- -- Debug Log Parser ------------------------------------- function Skinner.Debug.Log(msg) if not Skinner.Config.debug then return end ColourNote( "silver", "", string.format( "[DEBUG][%s] %s", Skinner.Session.state, msg ) )
end
-- Save State function OnPluginSaveState() SetVariable( "config", serialize.save_simple(Skinner.Config) ) SetVariable( "stats", serialize.save_simple(Skinner.Stats) ) end
-- Load
function LoadTable(name)
local s = GetVariable(name)
if s == nil or s == "" then return nil end
local f = loadstring("return "..s)
if not f then return nil end return f() end
function Skinner.Engine.ResetSession()
Skinner.Debug.Log("Resetting session.")
------------------------------------------------ -- Clear runtime queues ------------------------------------------------
Skinner.Session.corpseQueue = {} Skinner.Session.bonusCounts = {}
------------------------------------------------ -- Reset counters ------------------------------------------------
Skinner.Session.completed = 0 Skinner.Session.failed = 0
------------------------------------------------ -- Clear flags ------------------------------------------------
Skinner.Session.finishingRoom = false
------------------------------------------------ -- Disable scan triggers ------------------------------------------------
EnableTrigger("Skinner_Exits", false) EnableTrigger("Skinner_Corpse", false) EnableTrigger("Skinner_findPrompt", false)
------------------------------------------------ -- Return to idle ------------------------------------------------
Skinner.Engine.SetState(Skinner.State.IDLE)
end
-- Install function OnPluginInstall() local cfg = LoadTable("config") if cfg then for k, v in pairs(cfg) do Skinner.Config[k] = v end end local st = LoadTable("stats") if st then for k, v in pairs(st) do Skinner.Stats[k] = v end end Skinner.UI.Print("Version "..VERSION.." loaded.") end
function Skinner.Engine.Enable() Skinner.Config.enabled = true Skinner.UI.Print("Enabled.") Skinner.Engine.Save() end
function Skinner.Engine.Disable() Skinner.Config.enabled = false Skinner.Engine.ResetSession() Skinner.Engine.Save() Skinner.UI.Print("Disabled.") end
